step.inventory: Inventory: the agent reads the slice's norms and records reporting, proof, information, documentation, evaluation and control duties with their citation.
step.duplicates: Duplicates: duties that ask the same businesses for the same data are clustered; a register could supply the data.
step.prices: Prices: every duty and every option is priced with the compliance cost (Erfüllungsaufwand) method. Every figure has a source or carries the label Assumption.
step.decision: Decision: you approve, reject or ask for information. Only your approval enters the dossier, and nothing is sent.
